notes: The exact approved private server PDF is the only reference-book source. The workflow reads requested PDF pages one at a time and never writes page text, full-book text, OCR output or a search index. A selected short evidence quote may be saved with its exact PDF page in a durable decision.

Availability is time-sensitive. `pdf: verified-server-pdf` is only a catalog disposition; scripts/references/verified_reference_pdf.py and scripts/ops/reference-library-inventory.php verify the current approved PDF at use time. `missing` records an edition to leave pending; `nearest` is historical information and never authorizes a new substitution by default.
2026-10-10 inventory dispositions cover every official edition currently listed in catalog validity across residency, national, board and promotion exams. The live inventory is rechecked at use time.
